jobs.name: ratel
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: supplemental animation sprite atlas, exactly EIGHT columns by EIGHT rows, 64 equal SQUARE cells, 2048×2048 transparent PNG. Input image is a CHARACTER IDENTITY, SCALE AND POSE REFERENCE: preserve this exact same seated animal, proportions, clothes, body, feet, tail and warm Lion King / Lion Guard 2D hand-drawn animation look. Match the first neutral typing frame of the reference. DO NOT include its props except hands: there must be NO desk, laptop, chair, keyboard, floor, shadow or background anywhere in the new atlas. These will be separate stationary layers in the app.
Create FOUR smooth gestures of SIXTEEN genuinely different chronological drawings each, with all the in-between frames. Each gesture occupies TWO consecutive rows, read left-to-right along the first row then continue left-to-right along the second row. Do not reset the gesture in the middle.
Camera, seated torso, hips, feet and tail remain LOCKED across all 64 cells. No whole-body sliding, bouncing, zoom, rotation or foot shuffle. Every frame has identical framing, anchor and proportions. Full silhouette must stay inside its own cell, including ears, raised hand and tail; at least 16px clean empty margin. Heads around (125,78), feet baseline y=235 in 256px cells. Keep hands at keyboard level y=165, NOT on the knees! Fingers visibly articulate and arms reach the invisible keyboard at x=105..165,y=165. This is important so paws are clearly over the keyboard when composited with a fixed desk.
Rows 1+2: typing A, 16 consecutive frames. Focused soft smile, smooth alternating left/right fingers pressing a keyboard. Wrist and knuckles lift small distances between presses, real overlapping action. Occasional single eye blink. Start and end with same neutral keyboard pose so it joins other clips. Do not make the same eight drawings twice.
Rows 3+4: typing B with small personality gesture, 16 consecutive frames. Start typing, glance at viewer, one paw briefly loosens fingers in a tiny wrist stretch at keyboard height, a satisfied little smile and blink, then both paws resume typing. Keep torso and feet still. Start and end neutral typing.
Rows 5+6: finished / wave, 16 consecutive frames. Start neutral typing, face gradually brightens, one OPEN palm gradually lifts from keyboard to beside face, small friendly wave, then slowly lower to keyboard pose. Show smooth intermediate elbow, wrist and finger positions, not a raised fist. Torso and other paw stay still. Frame 16 returns to neutral keyboard pose.
Rows 7+8: waiting / playful sulk, 16 consecutive frames. Start neutral keyboard pose, gradually withdraw paws and cross arms, cheeks slightly puff, patient mildly grumpy eyebrows, small sigh and glance to side, then relax arms back to neutral keyboard pose. Charming funny sulking, no anger or tears. Real drawn in-betweens.
Isolated clean cartoon cutouts, genuinely transparent alpha, no colored panels, no grid lines, no labels, no text, no watermarks. Fixed stable scale and baseline across all 64 frames.
Subject: Gray honey badger / ratel, cream white head-to-back mantle, green eyes, black paws, short honey badger tail, no clothes.

jobs.name: renard
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. New supplemental animation atlas for the SAME friendly red fox in the reference, green eyes, orange fur, cream muzzle and white-tipped fluffy tail, sage green shirt. Same warm hand-drawn 2D cartoon outlines and cel shading. Exactly EIGHT columns and FOUR rows, 32 equal square cells on a transparent landscape 2048×1024 PNG. This is a new layout, not the reference layout.
Every row is a chronological eight-frame smooth gesture. Fixed seated body, feet and tail, fixed scale, camera and position in every cell. Only articulate paws, elbows, eyelids, mouth and brows. Full character in each cell, at least 16px margin. Hands reach an invisible keyboard at chest height. Do not draw any desk, laptop, chair, floor, backdrop, labels or watermark.
Row 1: typing, alternate finger presses with clear in-between hand positions and one blink. Start and end with neutral typing.
Row 2: typing with personality: starts typing, little stretch of one paw, friendly glance, then returns to typing. Eight distinct in-between drawings.
Row 3: task finished: smoothly raises an open palm from keyboard up beside head, waves briefly, then lowers back. Eight smooth frames, no fist and no jump.
Row 4: waiting: withdraws hands, folds arms, mildly puffs cheeks, puzzled impatient glance, relaxes again. Gentle playful sulk, not anger. Eight smooth frames.
No whole-body displacement, no standing up. Match the reference's identity, proportions and clothes. Clean alpha cutouts with consistent empty cell margins, no colored residue or background.
